name: Gail E. Mautner
tagline: Top rated Estate & Trust Litigation attorney in Seattle, Washington
education: University of California College of the Law, San Francisco (formerly UC Hastings)
about: Gail E. Mautner is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2003, 2005 - 2026. She works at Ballard Spahr LLP, located in Seattle, Washington, and provides legal services for issues involving Estate & Trust Litigation and Employment & Labor: Employer to the surrounding community.
Gail Mautner completed legal studies at University of California College of the Law, San Francisco (formerly UC Hastings) and graduated with the class of 1982. Gail Mautner passed the bar in 1983.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
